content: इक्ष्वाकुः .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of the celebrated ancestor of the Solar kings who ruled in Ayodhyā; [he was the first of the Solar kings and was a son of Manu Vaivasvata; (<ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Bhāg.</ls> क्षुवतस्तु मनोर्जज्ञ इक्ष्वाकुर्घ्राणतः सुतः); इक्ष्वाकुवंशोऽभिमतः प्रजानाम् <ls>U. 1. 44.</ls>] .²2 (<ab>pl.</ab>) Descendants of Ikṣvāku; गलितवयसामिक्ष्वाकूणामिदं हि कुलव्रतम् <ls>R. 3. 70</ls>. .{@-कुः@} {%f.%} A kind of bitter gourd, Cucurbita Lagenaria (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>कडू दुध्या</ns>).
